findings.title: Default DSN in source carries a credential-shaped value that reaches runtime when APP_DSN is unset
findings.description: The fallback DSN is compiled into the module and used by dsn() whenever APP_DSN is absent (line 6). The class is config, not secret: the value is a development default, but a deployment that forgets APP_DSN connects with it. gate keys the identity of this finding because the cited bytes match a redaction rule.
findings.impact: A production process started without APP_DSN uses the committed default credential.
findings.prerequisites: APP_DSN unset in the target environment.
findings.remediation: Fail fast when APP_DSN is absent; keep development defaults in an untracked .env.example.
